title: Everythings Amazing & Nobodys Happy
summary: A clip of Louis C.K.'s bit "Everything's Amazing and Nobody's Happy," about how quickly people take modern technology for granted and complain about it. It is a comedic riff on impatience with air travel and gadgets.
why: Posted constantly in threads about tech complaints as a reminder to appreciate how remarkable modern technology is.

quote.text: Maybe we need to watch this tube to see things in a more balanced way
